page_title: Foot Stomper: a kick drum I wear on my foot | Colin Calnan
description: An M5StickS3 on the instep feels a tap or a stomp and sends a kick drum over Bluetooth MIDI. Measured on real captures, built spec first.
title: Foot Stomper
sub: A kick drum I wear on my foot. Tap or stomp, and a bass drum plays through the PA.
